dashboard.overlay.title: Overlay
dashboard.overlay.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.
dashboard.overlay.hint: Add this address in OBS as a Browser source. Use localhost, not an IP address: YouTube's player refuses videos on a page opened by an IP address.
dashboard.overlay.theme_hint: Changes at once, also in OBS. To use another look in one source only, add theme=name to the end of its address, after a ? or a & (for example theme=pixel).
dashboard.overlay.chat_panel_hint: The chat of every source that is being read, on a panel. Add this address in OBS as a Browser source of 360 x 640; for the Ticker bar make the source as wide as the scene.
dashboard.overlay.chat_float_hint: The chat of every source that is being read, with nothing behind the lines but their own bubbles. Add this address in OBS as a Browser source of 360 x 640.
dashboard.update.title: Updates
dashboard.update.failed: Could not check. Is this computer online?
dashboard.update.off: The program does not look for updates by itself (check_updates in config.toml); the button still works.
dashboard.settings.youtube_superchat_byp: A Super Chat gets past the minimum role
dashboard.settings.chat_cooldown_secs: Per-user cooldown for this chat (seconds; empty: the general one)
dashboard.settings.chat_max_waiting: Most requests of this chat waiting at once (0: no limit)
dashboard.tiktok.title: TikTok chat
dashboard.tiktok.hint: The program reads the live chat of this account and follows a change at once, without a restart. Leave it empty to stop reading chat.
error.no_api_key: No YouTube API key is set. Enter one on the Account page to accept video requests.
dashboard.account.title: Account
dashboard.account.hint: Your profile, the chats this program reads and the credentials it uses. Credentials can only be changed from the computer the program runs on.
dashboard.profile.photo_bad: That file could not be read as a picture. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
dashboard.profile.name: Display name
dashboard.profile.hint: Shown next to your avatar in this dashboard only. Leave it empty to show "Account". It is kept on this computer.
dashboard.account.locked: You are connected from another computer, so you can see what is set but not change it. Open the dashboard on the computer that runs the program to change it.
dashboard.account.youtube.title: YouTube API key
dashboard.account.youtube.set: A key is set (it ends in {ending}).
dashboard.account.youtube.unset: No key is set. Video requests are refused until you enter one.
dashboard.account.youtube.source.saved: Saved from this dashboard. It replaces YOUTUBE_API_KEY, if that is set.
dashboard.account.youtube.source.environ: From the YOUTUBE_API_KEY environment variable or the .env file.
dashboard.account.youtube.label: New API key
dashboard.account.youtube.hint: The key is tried with one YouTube request (1 quota unit) before it is saved, takes effect at once, and is never shown again.
dashboard.account.youtube.saved_quota: Key saved. Today's YouTube quota is used up, so video lookups work again after it resets.
dashboard.account.error.key_bad_format: That is not shaped like a YouTube API key (no spaces or line breaks, at most 200 characters).
dashboard.account.error.key_rejected: YouTube refused this key. Check that it is right and that the YouTube Data API v3 is enabled for it.
dashboard.account.error.cannot_check: Could not reach YouTube to check the key. Nothing was changed; try again.
dashboard.account.error.not_saved: The key could not be written to disk, so nothing was changed.
dashboard.account.error.loopback_only: Credentials can only be changed from the computer the program runs on.
dashboard.account.token.title: Dashboard token
dashboard.account.token.unset: No token is set. The dashboard only accepts connections from this computer.
dashboard.account.token.hint: The token is set with DASHBOARD_TOKEN in .env. Making a new one from here will come later.
dashboard.requests.title: Requests
dashboard.requests.hint: Every request viewers sent, newest first. The list is kept between runs.
status.chat.tiktok.waiting_for_live: Waiting for @{channel} to go live on TikTok
status.chat.tiktok.not_set: No TikTok username yet. Enter it on the Account page to read the chat.
status.chat.tiktok.paused: TikTok chat disconnected. Choose Connect chat in the account menu to read it again.
status.chat.tiktok.disabled: TikTok chat is switched off. Switch it on in the Account page to read it.
status.chat.youtube.waiting_for_live: Waiting for the YouTube video {channel} to go live
status.chat.youtube.not_set: No YouTube live yet. Enter its link on the Account page to read the chat.
status.chat.youtube.paused: YouTube chat disconnected. Choose Connect chat in the account menu to read it again.
status.chat.youtube.disabled: YouTube chat is switched off. Switch it on in the Account page to read it.
dashboard.youtube_chat.title: YouTube live chat
dashboard.youtube_chat.hint: Paste the link of the YouTube live, or its 11-character ID. Only a public live works. A live has a new link each time, so paste it again for each stream. The chat is read without an API key, from the same page YouTube shows, so it can stop working if YouTube changes it. Leave it empty to stop reading chat.
dashboard.setup.hint: No chat to read yet. Enter a TikTok username or a YouTube live on the Account page.
